text: {"differences": [{"side": "en", "quote": "surplus renewable energy produced in the summer is stored for use in the winter by means of a thermochemical process", "severity": 0.4, "before": "SeasON's catchy slogan, 'today's energy – tomorrow's warmth', sums up what it is all about:"}, {"side": "tgt", "quote": "L’eccesso di energia rinnovabile viene immagazzinato in estate, per l’inverno, mediante un processo termochimico.", "severity": 0.4, "before": "Lo slogan accattivante di SeasON \"today’s energy - tomorrow’s warmth\" descrive di che cosa si tratta."}]}
